description: Playwright CLI for coding agents — a stateful browser session driven by shell commands (open/goto/click/fill), returning accessibility snapshots. More token-efficient than MCP. Installs the npm package '@playwright/cli'; the command is 'playwright-cli'.
notes: Install the bundled agent skill so Claude Code / Copilot know how to drive it: run 'playwright-cli install --skills' in your project (writes .claude\skills\playwright-cli), or '--skills=agents' for .agents\skills. Without it an agent can still read 'playwright-cli --help'.
Stateful: 'playwright-cli open <url>' starts a persistent browser session; later commands (goto, click e15, fill e5 "text", snapshot, close) act on that same session.

Browsers are NOT installed with this package. Run 'playwright install chromium' (from the 'playwright' manifest) or let the CLI prompt you; they land in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ms-playwright, shared with playwright and playwright-mcp.
pre_install: # some npm install scripts shell out to bare 'node'; this bucket keeps Node.js off PATH, so put it there for this process only
# npm also runs the package's own 'prepare' script, which can fail on a devDependency we deliberately skipped - what matters is that the dependencies landed
